title: Pin Rich Menu URI allowlists and clean up orphan menus on upload errors
context_summary: LINE Rich Menu provisioning creates menu IDs before uploading PNG content.
observation: Unpinned LIFF paths risked spoofing and failed PNG uploads could leave orphaned Rich Menus.
verified_action: Pin allowedLiffId and tenant clientCode subdomains, reject '..' segments, delete orphaned menus on failure, and target 2500x1686 PNG (<250 KB).

title: Auto-sync 2500x1686 Midnight Navy Rich Menus on startup and re-link per-user menu bindings
context_summary: Founder phone screenshot showed the legacy October white 6-card Rich Menu and raw Markdown in LINE plain text after typing 'show me your update menu'.
observation: Setting only the all-user default Rich Menu or requiring an exact 'richmenu: sync' command left users with prior per-user Rich Menu bindings on the old menu and routed natural update menu queries to free-form LLM Markdown.
verified_action: Auto-sync the 2500x1686 Midnight Navy Rich Menus on startup when richmenu_theme_version changes, re-link FOUNDER_LINE_ID and active client bindings, route natural update menu/team/activation phrases to LINE Flex Cards, and strip Markdown via stripLineMarkdown.
